1: // Simple Rocket Escape game
2: // Canvas id="game". Rocket can thrust (ArrowUp) and rotate (ArrowLeft/Right).
3: // Asteroids drift left to right, fuel cells appear occasionally.
4: // Survive as long as possible.
5: 
6: (() => {
7:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
8:   if (!canvas) return console.error('Canvas #game not found');
9:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
10:   const width = canvas.width = canvas.clientWidth || 800;
11:   const height = canvas.height = canvas.clientHeight || 600;
12: 
13:   // ----- Game objects -----
14:   const rocket = {
15:     x: width / 2,
16:     y: height - 50,
17:     angle: -Math.PI / 2, // pointing up
18:     vx: 0,
19:     vy: 0,
20:     size: 20,
21:     thrust: 0.1,
22:     rotateSpeed: 0.07,
23:     fuel: 100,
24:   };
25: 
26:   const asteroids = [];
27:   const fuels = [];
28:   let keys = {};
29:   let score = 0;
30:   let gameOver = false;
31: 
32:   // ----- Input handling -----
33:   window.addEventListener('keydown', e => (keys[e.code] = true));
34:   window.addEventListener('keyup', e => (keys[e.code] = false));
35: 
36:   // ----- Helpers -----
37:   function spawnAsteroid() {
38:     const size = 15 + Math.random() * 30;
39:     const speed = 1 + Math.random() * 2;
40:     const side = Math.random() < 0.5 ? 'left' : 'right';
41:     const y = Math.random() * (height / 2);
42:     asteroids.push({
43:       x: side === 'left' ? -size : width + size,
44:       y,
45:       vx: side === 'left' ? speed : -speed,
46:       vy: 0,
47:       size,
48:     });
49:   }
50: 
51:   function spawnFuel() {
52:     const size = 10;
53:     const x = Math.random() * (width - size * 2) + size;
54:     const y = Math.random() * (height / 2) + size;
55:     fuels.push({ x, y, size, collected: false });
56:   }
57: 
58:   function updateRocket() {
59:     if (keys['ArrowLeft']) rocket.angle -= rocket.rotateSpeed;
60:     if (keys['ArrowRight']) rocket.angle += rocket.rotateSpeed;
61:     if (keys['ArrowUp'] && rocket.fuel > 0) {
62:       rocket.vx += Math.cos(rocket.angle) * rocket.thrust;
63:       rocket.vy += Math.sin(rocket.angle) * rocket.thrust;
64:       rocket.fuel -= 0.2;
65:     }
66:     // Apply simple drag & gravity-like pull downwards
67:     rocket.vx *= 0.99;
68:     rocket.vy *= 0.99;
69:     rocket.vy += 0.02; // slight gravity
70:     rocket.x += rocket.vx;
71:     rocket.y += rocket.vy;
72:     // Keep within bounds
73:     if (rocket.x < 0) rocket.x = width;
74:     if (rocket.x > width) rocket.x = 0;
75:     if (rocket.y < 0) rocket.y = 0;
76:     if (rocket.y > height) { gameOver = true; }
77:   }
78: 
79:   function updateObjects() {
80:     // Asteroids
81:     asteroids.forEach(a => { a.x += a.vx; a.y += a.vy; });
82:     // Remove off‑screen
83:     for (let i = asteroids.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
84:       if (asteroids[i].x < -50 || asteroids[i].x > width + 50) asteroids.splice(i, 1);
85:     }
86:     // Fuels
87:     // (static, no movement)
88:   }
89: 
90:   function checkCollisions() {
91:     // Rocket vs asteroids
92:     for (let a of asteroids) {
93:       const dx = rocket.x - a.x;
94:       const dy = rocket.y - a.y;
95:       const dist = Math.hypot(dx, dy);
96:       if (dist < rocket.size + a.size) {
97:         gameOver = true;
98:         return;
99:       }
100:     }
101:     // Rocket vs fuels
102:     for (let f of fuels) {
103:       if (f.collected) continue;
104:       const dx = rocket.x - f.x;
105:       const dy = rocket.y - f.y;
106:       if (Math.hypot(dx, dy) < rocket.size + f.size) {
107:         f.collected = true;
108:         rocket.fuel = Math.min(rocket.fuel + 30, 100);
109:         score += 10;
110:       }
111:     }
112:   }
113: 
114:   function draw() {
115:     ctx.clearRect(0, 0, width, height);
116:     // Rocket
117:     ctx.save();
118:     ctx.translate(rocket.x, rocket.y);
119:     ctx.rotate(rocket.angle);
120:     ctx.beginPath();
121:     ctx.moveTo(rocket.size, 0);
122:     ctx.lineTo(-rocket.size / 2, rocket.size / 2);
123:     ctx.lineTo(-rocket.size / 2, -rocket.size / 2);
124:     ctx.closePath();
125:     ctx.fillStyle = '#ff0';
126:     ctx.fill();
127:     ctx.restore();
128:     // Asteroids
129:     ctx.fillStyle = '#777';
130:     for (let a of asteroids) {
131:       ctx.beginPath();
132:       ctx.arc(a.x, a.y, a.size, 0, Math.PI * 2);
133:       ctx.fill();
134:     }
135:     // Fuel cells
136:     ctx.fillStyle = '#0f0';
137:     for (let f of fuels) {
138:       if (f.collected) continue;
139:       ctx.beginPath();
140:       ctx.arc(f.x, f.y, f.size, 0, Math.PI * 2);
141:       ctx.fill();
142:     }
143:     // HUD
144:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
145:     ctx.font = '16px sans-serif';
146:     ctx.fillText(`Score: ${score}`, 10, 20);
147:     ctx.fillText(`Fuel: ${Math.floor(rocket.fuel)}`, 10, 40);
148:     if (gameOver) {
149:       ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.6)';
150:       ctx.fillRect(0, 0, width, height);
151:       ctx.fillStyle = '#f00';
152:       ctx.textAlign = 'center';
153:       ctx.font = '48px sans-serif';
154:       ctx.fillText('Game Over', width / 2, height / 2);
155:     }
156:   }
157: 
158:   // ----- Main loop -----
159:   let lastSpawn = 0;
160:   let lastFuelSpawn = 0;
161:   function loop(timestamp) {
162:     if (gameOver) {
163:       draw();
164:       return;
165:     }
166:     const delta = timestamp - (lastSpawn || timestamp);
167:     // Spawn asteroids every 1–2 seconds
168:     if (timestamp - lastSpawn > 1000 + Math.random() * 1000) {
169:       spawnAsteroid();
170:       lastSpawn = timestamp;
171:     }
172:     // Spawn fuel cells occasionally
173:     if (timestamp - lastFuelSpawn > 8000) {
174:       spawnFuel();
175:       lastFuelSpawn = timestamp;
176:     }
177:     updateRocket();
178:     updateObjects();
179:     checkCollisions();
180:     draw();
181:     requestAnimationFrame(loop);
182:   }
183: 
184:   requestAnimationFrame(loop);
185: })();
